Poltchageist

Grass Ghost

Paldea · Generation 9

Poltchageist is a Grass/Ghost-type Matcha Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.1 m tall and weighs 1.1 kg. It evolves into Sinistcha. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (74), with a base stat total of 308.
